page.layout: One page of running text in one column; left margin holds one marginal note with a reference mark ("Cap.1.") beside the paragraph beginning "Etenim ipse Galenus"; the printed bullet marks (») in the left margin are list markers, not notes. Running head at top; page number at top left; a signature-like word "Si" at the foot right, which is a catchword.

main_text.p: ad suum dogma confirmandum satis est ua lida. Post hanc, ad alia, quam a Galeno Fernelius se defumpsisse ait, nobis progredien dum est. Haec mihi (inquit Brutus Eudoxi argumenta probans) cum superioribus satis videntur cohaerere, si modo tu his eum Galeni locum concilies, qui in unaquaque similari parte ait substantias tres haberi, scilicet solidam, carnosam et spirituosam: ex quibus ait virium substantiam compleri. Eudoxus id quidem facile. Nam solida atque carnosa eam, quam dixi partis similaris materiam constituunt. Spirituosa, in qua calor est insitus ad formam referetur ac pertinet. Haec Fernelius, quibus (pace tanti viri dixerim) Galeni mentem, sensaque praue detorquet.

Cap.1.Etenim ipse Galenus undecimo Methodi medendi, non partem similarem ait, sed naturam verbis perspicuis exprimit. Natura (inquit) ex tribus his partibus constat, ex spiritus substantia, ex earum, quae verae dicuntur solidae, substantia (quas alibi ex femine genitali conditas esse monstrauimus) & tertia ab his carnosa, quae cuiq; particulae est sua. His Galenus, virium essentia in spiritus, carnis & solidarum partium iusta quantitate & qualitate consistere planum facit.

page.notes: Printed text is a mix of roman and italic; the scan is faded and the Latin of the middle lines was read with some uncertainty, so doubtful words are unmarked here only where the scan was clear. Probable printing errors left as printed: "ex tribus his partibus", "ex earum". The reference mark "1" in the text is not visible at its place in the body; the note "Cap.1." was printed in the left margin beside the paragraph. The letter-by-letter reading of the middle lines (from "Haec mihi" to "compleri") and of the lines "Spiritu osa" and "ex earum" is partly conjectural and should be checked against the scan. Bullet markers (») in the left margin are not text and are omitted. The final line "Si" is a catchword at the foot right.
